displayPlayerHealthEvents.title: Allow players to apply health statuses
displayPlayerHealthEvents.description: Show health statuses and condition warnings in the player HUD. Players can change statuses only on actors they own.

displayPlayerEffects.title: Allow players to apply effects
displayPlayerEffects.description: Show token effects and visible active effects in the player HUD. Players can change effects only on actors they own.

displayPlayerEyeAwareness.title: Allow players to see Eye Awareness
displayPlayerEyeAwareness.description: Show the company's Eye Awareness in the player HUD when the player can view the company and the TOR2E system allows players to see Eye Awareness.

addOverlayOnEffects.title: Enable token overlay for effect statuses
addOverlayOnEffects.description: Enable this option to apply a token overlay when applying effect statuses such as Dead, Unconscious, and Invisible.

shareCompanyResourceTotals.title: Share company resource totals
shareCompanyResourceTotals.description: Show Endurance and Hope totals for company members whose sheets players can view. When disabled, players see totals only for characters they own.

allowPlayerCharacterEdits.title: Allow player skill edits from the HUD
allowPlayerCharacterEdits.description: Allow players to change skill and combat proficiency ranks and toggle Favoured or Magical on characters they own. Players can still roll when edits are disabled.

actions.journeyEventHint: Open the system's journey event roll. Use the journey log sheet to record events.
actions.rankHint: Alt-click the diamonds to increase rank; Alt+Shift-click to decrease. Right-click for named rank controls.
actions.conditionWarning: The system reports a condition threshold. Open the sheet to review and apply the appropriate condition.
actions.hopeRecoveryPermission: Rest and Hope recovery require ownership of your character and the active Community. Ask the Loremaster to perform this action; the system cannot safely spend Fellowship Points with your current permissions.
actions.failed: The action could not be completed. Check the notification or console for details.
actions.rollHint: Click to open the system roll dialog. Right-click for secondary actions; keyboard: Shift+F10.
actions.rollOnlyHint: Click to open the system roll dialog.
actions.resourceHint: Click to open the system's controls for this value.
